hypothesis: Oceanic islands have a high endemic proportion despite low richness.
pass_criterion: Median endemic proportion across oceanic islands exceeds 30% and is higher than for continental areas of equal size.
fail_criterion: Median endemic proportion below 10%, or not higher than that for equal-area mainland.
interpretation: Needs island native and endemic counts and area. The candidate Dryad island dataset I fetched has native/alien/extinct status but no endemism field.
no_dataset_reason: No fetched dataset gives endemic and native counts with island area. GIFT's landing page rendered no description.
